title: Built a home for vibe-coded games to get discovered
author: JohnFlick
selftext:
I’ve been vibe coding a few games, and realized that getting people to actually play a game is harder than building the game itself now.

There are a ton of cool little browser games being built, but it seems like most of them get posted once somewhere and then kind of disappear.

So I built [**Vibecade**](https://vibecade.co).

The idea is basically a Miniclip / Addicting Games type site, but for this new wave of games being built with AI.

Games on the site have already received thousands of plays, which has been cool to see.

If you’ve built a game, you can submit it or link to it in this thread for me to add it.

Would be cool to get more of the stuff people are building in front of a larger audience.

[https://vibecade.co](https://vibecade.co)

replies.author: JohnFlick
replies.body:
Great feedback. 

1. GIFs are now supported.  
2. External site links are also supported. By default, if we're able to serve the embedded game, we'll do so — otherwise, users will be redirected to the external site.

Bloomoff has been approved.
